title: Chapter 475 Rapid Expansion Of Territory
content:
Chapter 475 Rapid Expansion Of Territory

Wang Shuo personally came to the city gate. Violet had been waiting for a long time with the main officials.

"Greetings to His Majesty the Emperor of the Vana Empire."

Violet took the lead in saluting, which surprised Wang Shuo.

He still couldn't believe that the emperor of a huge empire would surrender.

"Violet, why did you surrender?"

Wang Shuo asked puzzledly.

Violet smiled slightly and said in a soft voice: "Of course I surrendered because I thought I couldn't beat His Majesty!"

Wang Shuo was unable to refute.

After a dumb smile, Wang Shuo looked at Violet with a smile on his lips: "Then what do you want?"

At this time, Violet's eyes showed a trace of spirit: "I just want a peaceful life, away from the struggle for power, away from war and killing."

Wang Shuo was stunned, but then thought again, who doesn't want such a life?

It's just that people in the rivers and lakes can't help themselves.

Wang Shuo thought of his changes in the past few years.

From struggling to survive at the beginning, he was very satisfied to have a full meal and a good night's sleep.

Until now, I have been thinking about expanding the territory and unifying the Shenwu Empire.

Human ambitions and desires are never satisfied.

Seeing Violet's tired face, Wang Shuo believed that she was not lying.

"Well, officials in the Roland Empire, as long as they are willing to continue to work in politics and fight, can continue to serve the Wana Empire. If they are willing to retire, I will not make it difficult for them. Let you all live the life you want!"

"Thank you, Your Majesty."

A day later, the statistical results came out.

What made Wang Shuo a little regretful was that among the three strongest kings, only the former Grand Marshal Cao Jun was willing to continue to serve the empire.

The general was upset about surrendering and was unwilling to serve the Wana Empire again.

Everyone has his own ambitions, and Wang Shuo also respected his choice.

As long as he abides by the law, Wang Shuo will not make things difficult for him.

However, for this uncontrollable strongest king in the empire, Wang Shuo will definitely arrange personnel to monitor him in the place where he settles.

And it is stipulated that if you want to go out, you must report it.

If you don't agree, then go and settle in another empire.

...

In a very short period of time, the news of the Roland Empire's surrender spread to the surrounding empires.

This news caused an uproar.

The Mali Dynasty surrendered unconditionally at the first opportunity.

Even the forces around the Wana Empire surrendered after a short wait and see.

This surprised Wang Shuo.

In just a few months, the territory of the Wana Empire has expanded several times.

It has become a behemoth in the south of the Shenwu Empire, and its territory is close to the first-level empire.

Wang Shuo couldn't believe it when he saw the map of the Wana Empire's territory.

Because the northeast corner of the territory is adjacent to the Truni Empire.

There is only a river between the Wana Empire and the Truni Empire.

Wang Shuo looked at the map and smiled.

It can be said that the Truni Empire today is no match for the Wana Empire.

Wang Shuo immediately asked Guliji to infiltrate spies into the Truni Empire.

If you want to attack a huge empire, you must know it well.

If the other party has some unknown hidden strength, it is inevitable that something unexpected will happen.

A few days later, a team of envoys appeared in Wana City.

The people who came were sent by the current emperor of the Shenwu Empire, the former seventh prince.
